moments.text: Infrared view of plain grey sky with a crosshair and four bracket bars. A small bright spot sits just below the top bar.
The crosshair and bars vanish, leaving a small square box at centre. The spot, now a short streak, darts up, then down beside the box.
The spot shoots up to the top edge and leaves the view at 3.95 s; only the box, which widens, remains until the end.

notes: Clip is 5.0 s, summary says 11 s. Square IR picture inside black bars plus white pillarbox bars at far left/right; crop None, not cropped.
